newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends lower as dollar demand rises.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends lower as dollar demand rises.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed lower at 42.3400/42.3850 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday compared with the previous 42.30/42.38, dealers said.

Dealers said the taka, which opened unchanged, eased later as demand for dollar picked up on import requirements. "The rates have not yet stabilised after the central bank adjusted the taka downwards against the dollar," said one dealer with a foreign bank.

Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, adjusted the taka downwards at 42.20/42.40 from previous 42.05/42.25 against the dollar, effective on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
